commit.message:
Import PlatformInfo for isDarwin()

This work is sponsored by The FreeBSD Foundation

Fix hash code for MacOS, enhance performance

* Determine whether we're on MacOS or not once, rather than doing string
  comparisons every time different behaviour is needed.  Adjust code as
  appropriate.
* Use unique_thread_id to determine the hash code on MacOS, so that
  equals() and hashCode() agree.

Fix debugd connect test on FreeBSD

The BsdThread and BsdDebuggerLocal classes adds an extra field, and
methods to deal with a "uniqueThreadId" used on Macos. This is fine when
attaching directly to the debugee, since the debugger object returned
from the VM.getDebugger() method will already be a BsdDebuggerLocal
object, and we can treat it as that.

However, when debugging remotely (via debugd,) the debugger object
returned will be a RemoteDebuggerClient object, which _does not_
implement the required fields and methods for the macos
"uniqueThreadId". This would result in an exception when trying to cast
the returned RemoteDebuggerClient object to an incompatible
BsdDebuggerLocal class.

On Macos, this issue is tracked as JDK-8239062:
https://bugs.openjdk.org/browse/JDK-8239062

FreeBSD does not use the "uniqueThreadId" field, so this patch just
bypasses that entirely for remote debugging sessions on FreeBSD.

This patch applies to AMD64 and Aarch64 architectures. The PPC post does
not use the "uniqueThreadId" field, and should not be affected.
